name: Voice-first second brain for Apple Watch

mentions.name: Voice-first second brain for Apple Watch
mentions.description: This Apple Watch app acts as a voice-first second brain: it captures thoughts instantly from the wrist via the Apple Watch Ultra's Action button or Siri keywords, working without an iPhone nearby by using cellular or Wi-Fi. Audio is transcribed with EU-based speech-to-text with zero data retention and turned into searchable notes and summaries.
mentions.problem: Capture a thought before forgetting it, without pulling out the phone.
mentions.audience: Capture a thought before forgetting it, without pulling out the phone.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building a voice-first second brain for Apple Watch. The idea is simple: capture thoughts instantly from your wrist using the Ultra’s Action button or Siri keywords, without needing your iPhone nearby (using cellular or wi-fi).

Audio is transcribed using EU-based speech-to-text with zero data retention, then turned into searchable notes and summaries.
